row.scim_price_text: Business: $80/mo (annual, org-level base price with default pre-paid data)
row.team_price_text: Team: $26/mo (annual, org-level base price with default pre-paid data)
row.evidence: Sentry's pricing page lists 'SAML + SCIM support' on the Business plan ($80/mo billed annually) and not on Team ($26/mo); the SCIM API docs say customers 'must be on a Business Plan with SAML2 Enabled'.
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated, Business). Prices are org-level base subscriptions with usage-based data on top, not per user (Team includes unlimited users), so per-user fields and the multiplier are now null; June had stored $26 and $80 as per-user values and a 3.1x multiplier. June's monthly-billing Business price ($89/mo) was not re-verified (the page text shows the annual price). SAML SSO is also Business+; Google and GitHub sign-in on Team are not SAML. SCIM can only set `active` (false permanently deletes the org member) plus the custom sentryOrgRole; name fields are returned as N/A. Okta, Entra and JumpCloud catalogue apps provision; OneLogin is documented for SAML only.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $26/mo when billed annually with default pre-paid data
plans.notes: Org-level base price, unlimited users; Google and GitHub sign-in available (not SAML).

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: $80/mo when billed annually with default pre-paid data

auth.token_source: Settings > Auth > General Settings > Enable SCIM; the SCIM Information panel shows the Auth Token and SCIM Base URL

operations.notes: Deactivate (active=false) permanently deletes the org member. Only PATCH is documented; JumpCloud's Sentry page says PUT is not supported.

filtering.notes: Only the eq operator; filterable attributes not listed.

core: emails (primary, single; secondary emails not supported)

custom.how: sentryOrgRole (core-schema extension attribute) sets the organization-level role: billing, member, manager or admin

roles.how: sentryOrgRole attribute (Okta group attribute) maps to org-level roles; Owner cannot be provisioned; changing role requires deprovision and reprovision

limitations.text: SCIM cannot set any user attribute other than active (and sentryOrgRole); passwords are not synced.
name.givenName/familyName are not supported and returned as N/A; Okta Import Users is not supported.
GET Groups returns at most 10,000 members per group.
Owner role cannot be provisioned through SCIM.
Members and team memberships assigned by the IdP can only be changed through the IdP.

endpoints.purpose: Add or invite a member (orgRole, teamRoles)
Update a member's org-level and team-level roles
Add a member to a team
Remove a member from a team

webhooks_user_events.notes: Integration-platform webhook resources are installation, event_alert, issue, metric_alert, error, comment, seer and preprod_artifact; no member events.

rate_limits.text: Per caller and endpoint fixed-window requests-per-second limit plus a concurrent-request limit; exposed in X-Sentry-Rate-Limit-* headers. Numbers vary per endpoint.

limitations.text: Changing organization roles via the member PUT endpoint is restricted to user auth tokens.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked.

google.notes: Sentry's 'Google Business App' is Google OAuth sign-in with domain restriction (Team+), not a Google Workspace SAML/provisioning app; no Google catalogue page checked.

onelogin.notes: From Sentry's SSO docs (OneLogin catalogue page not loaded); Sentry documents SCIM setup only for Okta and Azure AD.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace domain-restricted sign-in and GitHub Organizations sign-in (Team+)

open_questions: Docs do not say whether a public audit-log API exists or which plan has audit logs.
SCIM token expiry is not documented (Entra calls it a long-lived bearer token).
Whether SCIM deprovisioning ends active sessions is not documented.
OneLogin provisioning support not documented; OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.
Monthly-billing prices not captured from the page text.
